Personalized Design & Craftsmanship For Your Home Starts Here.

At ALL Renovation & Design, it is our goal to help clients to discover a creative solution, so their desires and dreams for their remodel can become a reality. To meet this goal, we tailored our process to focus on collaboration and communication.

Past clients regularly express that they felt heard and that our team captured everything they were looking for. We're excited to do the same for your upcoming remodeling project.

WHY US?
Trusted. Custom. Personal.
TRUSTED.
Remodeling Homes with Expert Craftsmanship.

ALL Renovation & Design is a home remodeling contractor dedicated to the highest standards of excellence and exceeding our clients' wants and needs. No exceptions.

CUSTOM.
Custom Designs for Your Project.

Our goal is to help our clients discover a creative solution together, so their desires and dreams can become a reality. Our creative design process focuses on collaboration and communication.

PERSONAL.
We Work with Your Ideas, Your Vision, And Your Budget.

We focus on solid communication and premium-quality projects. Our team of experienced home remodeling craftsmen are ready to turn your dreams for your house into a reality.

HOME SERVICES
OUR NAME SAYS IT ALL!

We do everything: inside to outside, top to bottom. The goal is to exceed your expectations - every time!

HOME ADDITIONS

Whether you are looking to expand your kitchen, add a new family room, or create a master bedroom suite, together we will create an addition and renovation plan that adds value and comfort to your home.

HOME REMODELING

With decades of experience kitchen remodels, bathroom remodels, and performing upgrades to home interiors and exteriors, our team can give you a more comfortable, enjoyable space to live.

OUTDOOR LIVING

Enjoy your backyard more by adding an updated outdoor living space. Upgrades to your home’s outdoor living areas not only create more comfortable locations for your family to play or relax, it adds value to your home.

OUR PROCESS
WE KEEP REMODELING SIMPLE:
Phone Conversation & Advice
In-Home Consultation & Walkthru

Watch Your Space Transform!

EXCELLENT
Based on 63 reviews
Dennis Trupe
ALL made some repairs to our patio deck that Amos installed 15 years ago. The workers also rebuilt flower boxes that had deteriorated over the years. The workers reinforced some joists and added some additional materials to ensure the stability of the deck. The workers were courteous, worked hard under hot weather conditions, and showed true craftsmanship in their work. We would definitely recommend ALL Renovations if you looking for quality work!
Amanda Chau
ALL Renovation installed a new beautiful kitchen window for us. Since the initial consultation through to the installment, they were communicative and extremely professional. They were very quick with the work and made sure to be thoroughly respectful with our space. Everything was left clean at the end of the job. We were extremely satisfied and would certainly work with them again!
Mary Gildea
This was a small bathroom remodel and attic upgrade project. The team at ALL Renovation & Design was exceptional from the start. Ronda was very helpful in designing a small physical space and staying within my budget. Randy did an amazing job in all areas, including electrical, plumbing, tiling, and drywalling. He was very easy to work with and the finished product is exactly as I envisioned it.
Liz Hagg
This is our fourth renovation project with All Renovation, and once again they exceeded our expectations. Over the years, they have helped us with opening up a wall, a full kitchen renovation, attic insulation, and drywall work. Most recently, they completed a full primary bathroom renovation that included new flooring, cabinets, a larger shower, a stand-alone tub, heated floors, and a new toilet. The finished product is beautiful, and the quality of the work is top-notch. David, who worked on most of our project, is meticulous and takes tremendous pride in both his craftsmanship and work ethic. His attention to detail really shows in the final result. We highly recommend All Renovation and look forward to working with them again on future projects.

OUR STORY

Hi, my name is Amos Lapp.

I founded ALL Renovation & Design LLC in 2006 with a simple goal: to serve my clients through a high level of craftsmanship in all areas of construction and remodeling. Since then, we’ve helped hundreds of homeowners in southcentral PA achieve the home of their dreams.

Coming from an Amish background, I have always enjoyed the hard work and details that are involved in making a project come to life. Our team of skilled designers, cabinetmakers, carpenters, and finishers now bring that passion to every project. We painstakingly sweat over every last detail, so that the finished product exceeds your expectations.

Our Guarantee: A Professional Timely Process Hitting the Mark Every Time!
Chat on the phone

We believe that every project we undertake should be a win-win. To accomplish that, we first must listen. During this initial phone conversation, our staff will listen and ask follow-up questions to better understand what your plans, goals, budget, and dreams are for your project. We’ll also review our process with you and set expectations for what we can bring to the project. At the end of this call, if we both feel that ALL Renovation is a good fit for your project, we’ll schedule an in-home consultation.

Contact us today to start on this part of the process.

In-Home Consultation

During this first in-person meeting, our staff will walk through your home, take measurements, and further discuss your goals and must-haves for the project. We’ll review any structural limitations or additional work that would need to happen to make your project a success. By the end of this meeting, we will determine if the project is feasible, can be done within your budget, and can be completed within your desired timeframe. If we agree on these three elements, we will provide a documented preliminary concept with a realistic budget expectation.

Design Agreement & Project Plan

No two houses or two home remodeling projects are alike. That’s why we create a realistic, custom plan that’s based on your goals and the unique features of your home.

We’ve discovered that projects flow better when everything is selected before construction begins. Our capable designers will walk you through the selection process, which can occur in our showroom, at a vendor’s showroom, or in your home. During this time, we’ll also begin the permitting and zoning process to uncover potential issues that could affect the project’s feasibility.

A signed design agreement and a small, non-refundable financial commitment are required to start this process.

When the design process is completed, we will provide a detailed Project Plan, which includes all your selections, color schemes, ideas and visuals, the project start date, expected duration, final costs, and all options/allowances. Once you sign the Project Plan contract and provide a deposit payment, we will move on to construction.

Construction Phase

We understand how inconvenient a renovation or construction project can be for you and your family; at times, it feels like your home is being invaded. That’s why we work hard to minimize our impact on the rest of your home. We will barricade the work site as much as we can, even erecting temporary walls if necessary. During construction, you can expect to hear from our team members at least twice a day, letting you know the progress of the work and the plan for the next day of work. He will always be available to answer any questions or concerns you may have.

Follow-up

After the project is complete, we will have a final walkthrough of the jobsite. We want to ensure you are 100% completely satisfied with our work, and we will call in our staff to fix something on the spot if we find something.

We’ll also reach out to you 3 and 6 months after the project to see how you are enjoying your new space. And if you ever have any questions or need repairs, we are just a phone call away.

FAQ

We are devoted to having not just professional service, but also communicating and answering your questions about home renovations.

ANSWERS
Are Your Project Estimates Free?

We focus more on conversations and relationships than a one-off estimate. All projects begin with a conversation. We ask questions, discuss details, and determine whether it’s a good fit. That conversation has no cost.

If the relationship seems like a good match, we continue to the next step, which is an in-home consultation. This visit also has no cost.

If we decide to move forward together after the conversation in your home, we will provide a preliminary estimate or preliminary solution for the project. This also has no cost!

The advantage to this conversation-based system, rather than a quick free estimate, is the connection we can form. You will meet with someone interested in understanding your goals and desires for your project. We want to fully understand your dreams for the house or the room, your timeline, and your budget.

This process provides you with an accurate cost analysis for your project and goals, which means you won’t see a higher estimate later on because the initial estimate was completely off base.

ANSWERS
What Are Some Planning Mistakes To Avoid?

Having a flexible mindset with the homeowner to manage anything that comes up is key in planning and approach. We put a lot of effort into outlining a project with the least amount of time as possible to accommodate the client. The planning mistake we run into the most often with clients is them expecting too short of a timeline, which doesn’t allow for flexibility.

In the planning stage, we must remember that a real home renovation timeline isn’t like the shows you see on HGTV. Those shows wrap up entire fixer-uppers in an hour. In reality, these changes take weeks.

We also recommend setting communication expectations with your contractor. Regular communication will keep things running smoothly. Plan to work with someone who is a good communicator and understands your communication preferences.

You’ll also want to discuss structural integrity issues with your contractor. Let’s say you would like a wall removed. It may not be as easy as it looks. Is there plumbing or HVAC lines there? Is it a load-bearing wall? Will it affect the floor?

As the homeowner, you can work in the planning stage to understand that a building’s structural integrity will dictate and sometimes limit your options. However, most of the time we’re able to work around limitations to accomplish the project’s goals.

ANSWERS
When Is the Best Time To Do a Home Remodeling Project? Does Timing Matter?

The best timing is whatever works best for you, the homeowner. When would a renovation project be least disruptive to your lifestyle and schedule?

Winter can be a good time to complete interior projects since they’re not dependent on waiting for fairer weather. For a home addition, spring is the best time to start or start in late summer and go into the fall.

If you’re not comfortable having workers in your home while you’re not there, we can work around your schedule.

It really depends on your preferences and schedule. We’ve completed projects for teachers who preferred us to work in the summer when they were home. We’ve also done projects for homeowners who preferred the work to be done during the school year when their kids are out of the house.

ANSWERS
What Are Some Common Price Ranges for Your Home Remodeling Projects?

Kitchen: A kitchen remodel can range from $65,000 to as low as $30,000. The lower end excludes appliances, and may not include flooring or new lighting or granite countertops.

A higher-end project could be in the $120,000 to $50,000 range. This is more likely to involve new cabinets, flooring, granite or quartz countertops, new fixtures and tiling, appliances, and other updates for the room. Typically, most of our projects involve creative design with functionality and aesthetics in mind throughout the entire kitchen and connecting spaces. Therefore, the kitchen remodel price range varies significantly from project to project.

Bathroom: A typical bathroom remodel price range is between $35,000 and $18,000 but can require an even greater investment if there is a lot of tile (walls, floor, or both) or a large shower. A lower-end bathroom upgrade can include fiberglass tubs or showers, a vinyl floor, and new fixtures. The middle and higher ranges usually include tile floors, a linen closet or other storage, and a glass surround or tiled shower.

ANSWERS
What Is Your Typical Project Lead Time?

Timeframes can vary depending on the time of year (whether we have a higher project load), design process, and size of the project.

For a kitchen project, we work with a 3-6 month lead time. That time includes the initial conversation, preliminary assessment or solution, the design process and selection, and then construction (on average this is about 8 weeks).

A bathroom typically takes around 2 months (average 4 weeks to in remodeling phase). Smaller projects can be done more quickly (1 month or less).

Additions take more time. They include zoning details, permits, stormwater management, and a lot of extra considerations that can take up to 6 months to a year to work through. Additions require more detailed blueprints and plans too.

For example, if you’d like to start a project in spring, start talking with a contractor in the fall. If you'd like to start in the summer, connect with us in the beginning of winter.

How Would You Describe Your Design Style?

Our design style is your design style. We’ll work collaboratively with you to make your vision a reality, regardless of the style. If it’s a farmhouse, we’ve done some beautiful farmhouse country looks. If it’s industrial or modern or vintage, we’ve done exemplary work in those styles too.

We sometimes work with third-party designers to be sure we’re providing exactly what our client wants. We can create 3D drawings too, as needed or requested.

For example, we worked with a homeowner who had a statement piece of furniture they wanted to match everything to (the colors, style, details, and the trim). We brought in an interior designer who collaborated with us, not just discussing the kitchen flooring or cabinets, but the decorations, wall color, trim, and the overall look the homeowner was going for.

Regardless of style, our focus is always on quality in our workmanship and service every step of the way because that’s how we produce the best value for you.

What Will Happen to My Home During the Process?

The demo process is a messy process, and it gets worse before it gets better.

We have a process to protect your home’s floors, furniture, and other items in the home. We’ll work with you to make sure things are out of the way so there’s as little disruption to your home as possible. We also barricade or put up plastic on walls and entryways to contain dust and debris from entering non-work areas.

We communicate constantly and will be up-front with you about what will be happening to make sure everyone is comfortable with what’s going on. It can feel a bit like a home invasion. The area in your home being worked on might be ripped up and look pretty awful before it starts coming together.

However, every day before our crew leaves a project, they will clear and clean the work area(s). We know that the project will cause disruptions in your life and we want to make it as comfortable as we possibly can. We hear from clients all the time how pleased they were that the work areas were kept so clean and organized throughout the project.

Can I Request Changes After Work Has Begun?

Yes, but it may add costs to redo work or acquire new materials. Some smaller items may be quick with minimal cost, such as an additional light or changing a paint color.

Typically, our design process is very thorough to avoid costly changes down the line. However, sometimes during remodeling, you find things you weren’t expecting and changes might be needed.

Lastly, we often encourage homeowners to wait and see the finished product. The wall color or countertop might look different than you had expected, but when you see it all together it looks great.

ANSWERS
Tell me a little bit about yourself.

I grew up in the Amish community. Although I was born in Lancaster, my family moved to western Indiana when I was 13. After my wife and I had our three sons, we moved back to the area in 2005. After our sons, we had two more children, both girls. Ben is the oldest, followed by Isaiah, Josiah, Charity, and Rebecca. We also have a golden retriever named Kevin.

We’re involved with many different sports, as well as Trail Life, which is a Christian outdoor adventure program for boys. The troop in Lititz includes 60 boys that I help to coordinate in high adventure trips. I work in this organization on several National Committees and as a new troop organizer in our area.

Anna, my wife, helps folks in our community by cleaning their homes, and also helps people improve their lives with her health products business.

We’ve got one big, happy family into all kinds of things!

Tell me a little about the events that led up to where you are now.

I started learning carpentry with my dad when I was 14. My grandfather was a fine- trim carpenter in Lancaster and it seems I have those genes. I love crafting and creating, using my carpentry skills.  I have always enjoyed the hard work and details that are involved in making a project come to life.

When we moved here from Indiana, I initially connected with another company and then branched out on my own. I founded ALL Renovation & Design in 2006 with a simple goal: to serve my clients through a high level of craftsmanship in all areas of construction and remodeling. Since then, we have helped hundreds of homeowners in southcentral PA achieve the home of their dreams.

What is your business and what makes it distinctive?

Our business is to help clients by working together with them to find the right solution for their dreams to become a reality. We focus on solid communication and premium-quality projects. Our team of skilled cabinetmakers, carpenters, and finishers bring passion to every project. We painstakingly sweat over every detail, so that the finished product exceeds your expectations.

What sets us apart? I recently met with a homeowner, and they asked me that question too – ‘Why should we buy from you?’

Here are the reasons clients have told us why they enjoy working with us:

They say we listen and care about what they want to accomplish. I’ve had many come to me and say we listened so carefully and put together a design and a plan exactly fitting their dreams, and along the way we helped them discover all the little details they really wanted. We are also comfortable with taking on jobs that might not be as clear-cut and involve complexity. That may not be the case with all companies. We have tailored our process to focus on collaboration and communication. Past clients regularly express that they felt heard and that our team captured everything they were looking for.

We invest a lot in relationships, and many of our clients have become friends. When we work with people, the focus and the goal is to build relationships, to build that trust factor. We care about them and what they want to accomplish.

Given your business expertise and the nature of what you do, what advice can you offer to residents?

I think I would say to not feel pressure to sign any contracts or make any agreements on the spot with a business. I have seen people get caught up in the sales quote process, feeling pressured into making a decision quickly, and many times that doesn’t turn out too well.

While I was at a customer’s home recently, sitting down and chatting with them, they told me they were so glad I was there to talk about the project without pressure. They’d had others come in, take a look at the roof, give them a price on the spot and lean on them to sign a contract before the salesperson left. I am happy to take the time to make sure it’s a right fit.

Many things can happen unexpectedly with renovations, and it’s your home, so it’s best to have strong communication throughout the project and that is what we specialize in. Client Testimonials

We like to think our work speaks for itself, but our clients love sharing their opinion as well. Read our customer reviews below!

Google Reviews
5-STAR FEEDBACK
"You cannot find a more trustworthy company than ALL Renovation & Design. From start to finish they will make your entire experience enjoyable. Don’t worry if you do not know exactly what you want, the ALL team will help guide you every step of the project. We never believed our home could be so beautiful. We have completed 3 projects with ALL Renovation, including master bathroom, kitchen and outdoor entertainment area. We feel like we have a brand-new home. We’re now happy to stay home and entertain our family and friends who can’t stop commenting on how beautiful our home has become. We cannot say enough about how happy we were to work with Amos and his staff. Everyone does exceptional work and could not be any nicer. We feel like they are part of our family and will always select them for any home remodel needs."
Deb & Hal T.
5-Star Review
Working with the ALL renovation team was awesome, start to finish. Unlike some other projects we have done, there were no surprises, no change orders, and no need for us to manage all of the details. Our designer was wonderful and helped us figure out what we wanted and needed inside the budget we had. The project was worked on by really nice and professional craftsmen that we felt very comfortable having in our home, and the work was completed on Budget and ahead of schedule. I can not say enough about this team.
Brian G.
5-Star Google Review
We've indeed been blessed to have found Amos, and his team, at ALL Renovations & Design. "Famous Amos", as I address him, was a 'one man team' when we first contracted with him to completely renovate our master bathroom. Our 58 year old split level home, located on the outskirts of Reading, has been upgraded on every level, from the top of the chimney to the old basement six levels below (and the attached garage). Their Quality Craftsmanship, fair pricing, dependable follow-up (if necessary) & honest Team Oriented employees rate an A+++. Highly recommended!
George & Phyllis S.
5-Star Google Review
"We did a remodel of our master bathroom with a replacement of our tub with a walk in shower. Amos made the process easy. The whole company is professional and courteous plus an A for communications. They have numerous options in materials to pick from and will guide you to what will work and what you may want to reconsider. Ronda, in the design department, made some good selections on lighting and finishes. David did the majority of our work and would consult with us during the project to make sure it was right. We were impressed with his knowledge of the trade. So, a big thanks to ALL Renovation and Design. A job well done."
Sharon H.
5-Star Google Review
"Amos and his team were great to work with. He really helped with the design for a new, enlarged master bath. He took Carolyn's vision and executed it perfectly. His team were on time, careful, and clean. Highly recommend Amos and his team."
John M.
5-Star Review
We recently got a total redo of our master bathroom by ALL. I am beyond pleased with the outcome! From Ronda's expert design assistance, to Mike P.'s AMAZING craftsmanship, the results exceed my expectations! Ronda elevated the look, and Mike delivered excellence with his expert talent! They were super great to work with too. I really can't say enough about their skills. They are truly gifted and talented. The pictures do not do their work justice!! Thank you ALL!! A top-notch business! Everyone we worked with was completely engaged in the process. We had new kitchen countertops and a backsplash installed, and are extremely satisfied with all aspects. From Ronda assisting in the design to Dan's expert installation. Highly recommend!
Cindi R.
5-Star Google Review
"ALL gave us the kitchen of our dreams. They listened to our ideas and created exactly what we wanted. ALL workmen were professional and considerate thru the entire process. The quality ALL provides is remarkable! The crew leader made the process easy and comfortable. They finished on time and on budget! We get rave reviews from all our friends and neighbors when they see our beautiful and modern kitchen. We highly recommend that anyone interested in remodeling call ALL Renovation & Design for a consultation."
Theresa C.
5-Star Review
"We had wanted to remodel our kitchen for several years but didn't know who to contact. We chose to use ALL Renovation and Design after talking with Amos Lapp at a Home Show. Amos was extremely helpful in the design process for the new kitchen and provided invaluable assistance in the selection process as well. We were particularly impressed with his team member David's workmanship and attention to detail. We are very happy with our new kitchen and would highly recommend ALL Renovation and Design to anyone looking for outstanding craftsmanship and service."
Patty B.

My wife and I partnered with ALL Renovations for a bathroom renovation where the final product displays quality from a group of individuals that are masters of their craft. We wanted an amazing experience and not stress and excuses. Everything went perfectly from our perspective. The value they provide for the cost is well balanced and the team is professional and considerate during the project. We look forward to working with them again.

Carpenter Technician – Field Team

We are seeking a Carpenter Technician to join our remodeling team. This role is designed for an individual who wants to build a long-term career in the skilled trades and grow within a professional remodeling company.

The right person does not need to know everything already. We value attitude, character, work ethic, and willingness to learn just as much as experience.

We are looking for someone who:
• Has integrity and strong personal character
• Is coachable and open to instruction
• Takes initiative without needing constant direction
• Works well with others and contributes positively to the team
• Demonstrates humility and professionalism
• Wants to grow in the remodeling and carpentry industries

Responsibilities may include:
• Assisting with residential remodeling projects
• Demolition and jobsite preparation
• Framing and basic carpentry work
• Finish carpentry installation
• Material handling and organization
• Maintaining clean and safe jobsites
• Supporting lead carpenters and project managers
• Learning company systems and building practices
• Potentially working 10-12 hour days

Preferred qualifications:
• Residential carpentry or construction experience
• Trade school education or hands-on experience
• Familiarity with basic hand and power tools

Required qualifications:
• Valid driver’s license
• Reliable transportation
• Ability to lift and carry materials
• Dependable attendance
• Positive attitude and willingness to learn
• Lives within 30 minutes of Manheim, PA
• Timeliness and punctuality

What We Offer:
• Full-time consistent work
• Opportunity for advancement
• Hands-on training and mentorship
• Team-oriented culture
• Professional remodeling environment
• Long-term career opportunity in the trades

We are committed to building a team of people who care about quality workmanship, professionalism, and serving homeowners well.

Sometimes you need more space than you do touching up a piece of your home. Let's explore the idea of adding a new addition to your home this year.

Home Addition Services for Lancaster Homeowners

ALL Renovation & Design is a licensed home addition contractor serving southcentral PA. Since 2006, we’ve helped homeowners like you reach past their existing walls to create unique spaces that achieve their dreams.

Perhaps you need another bedroom for a child or to host guests. Or maybe you would like additional space for entertaining or unwinding. Gain the extra living space you desire by adding a custom-designed addition to your home.

Our addition designers will listen to your goals and create a custom plan to meet your need for extra space. Following our custom process we’ll help you develop a plan around your goals and budget, design your space, and bring it to completion.

Whether you are looking to expand your kitchen, add a new family room, or create a master bedroom suite, together we will create an addition and renovation plan that adds value and comfort to your home.
